We’re co-hosting OPEN @ UNGA 81 with
@creativecommons.bsky.social  in NYC on Sept. 21.

At 1:30pm, we’re moderating a panel on: 

Can open source make AI markets less centralized?

With Duane O’Brien, Amanda Casari, Madiha Zahrah Choksi & Ben Moskowitz

Register: https://creativecommons.org/event/open-unga-81-a-conversation-on-collaboration/
